questions.question: The Second Five year Plan stressed rapid industrialization and the public sector. It was drafted and planned under the leadership of ________ .

questions.question: In a capitalist society the goods produced are distributed among people __________ .
questions.option_1: on the basis of what people need and on the basis of Purchasing Power
questions.option_2: not on the basis of what people need but on the basis of Purchasing Power
questions.option_3: only on the basis of what people need
questions.option_4: not on the basis of Purchasing Power
